text: Every failure to perform an obligation obliges the debtor to compensate the damage that the creditor suffers as a result
text_nl: Iedere tekortkoming in de nakoming van een verbintenis verplicht de schuldenaar de schade die de schuldeiser daardoor lijdt te vergoeden
notes: Central duty rule. Debtor and creditor are the paired actors; damage is the residual concept the whole book will re-use.

text: unless the failure cannot be attributed to the debtor
text_nl: tenzij de tekortkoming de schuldenaar niet kan worden toegerekend
notes: Defense qualifier on .a. Attribution is defined in 6:75 — should surface a semantic edge.

text: Insofar as performance is not already permanently impossible, paragraph 1 only applies with due observance of what is determined in the second paragraph regarding the debtor's default
text_nl: Voor zover nakoming niet reeds blijvend onmogelijk is, vindt lid 1 slechts toepassing met inachtneming van hetgeen is bepaald in de tweede paragraaf betreffende het verzuim van de schuldenaar
notes: Scoping clause. 'Insofar as' kept as text-level qualifier, not tagged as hierarchy (reserved for 'without prejudice' / 'subject to' / 'notwithstanding').
